create_content_chunk: create a ContentChunk with text, mime type, and role for multi-modal inference input
load_data_from_file: load LOFT dataset queries, corpus passages, answers, and metadata from a data directory
run_one_example: run multi-turn inference on a LOFT Example using a model and return structured results
extract_prediction: extract a list prediction from model output by parsing bracketed values after an answer prefix
create_example: create an Example with context chunks, query turns, gold answers, and corpus document boundaries
